system.description:
This bioware modification enhances the character’s chemical synapses and juices their neurotransmitters, drastically speeding up neural connections. Neurachem can be mentally activated or triggered by charged emotions. Level 1 neurachem increases the character’s Speed stat by +1, with no side effect. Level 2 raises the Speed stat by +2, but each time it is used the character suffers a nervous system fatigue hangover for 1 hour after the boost wears off (apply a –20 modifier to all actions).

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 305.
